parties: Hexagon Nutrition Limited; Ms. Anuradha Kelkar (Promoter group member)
headline: Hexagon Nutrition: Promoter group member acquires 15,000 equity shares
sum: Ms. Anuradha Kelkar, a promoter group member of Hexagon Nutrition Limited, acquired 15,000 equity shares, triggering a SEBI Regulation 29(2) disclosure filing with the NSE.
implication: Routine promoter-group acquisition disclosure under SEBI takeover code; confirms substantive acquisition threshold compliance and insider disclosure discipline at listed company level.
detail: The transaction was disclosed under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 29(2), which mandates disclosure of acquisitions by persons belonging to the promoter or promoter group. Hexagon Nutrition Limited notified the NSE of the share acquisition. The filing appears routine and does not indicate change of control or material group restructuring.
